title: 第十九章 朕只要一直都不倒不就行了第二十章 规划未来
slug: 一统天下后方知此世有仙
content_zh:
“否则呢？”
窗外阴雨连绵，谢苍荣站在窗边，透过窗棂的缝隙，静静地远眺着。
同样是私下面会臣子，此刻他却面色沉着，有些严肃，并无在柳秉玄和宫巧面前时那般春风和煦。
“齐卿，功劳总要有个归属，朕不拿，难道该将之归于修士么？令百姓敬仰信奉之，奉若神明，以致‘法王’凌驾‘人王’之上？”谢苍荣侧首，挑眉反问，“如此，我大夏与仙盟治下之国，又有何异？”
站在谢苍荣跟前的是个约莫四十岁的男子，身形高挑，面容瘦削，着一袭灰色衣袍，眉眼低垂，看上去并无锐气。
他闻言皱了皱眉头：“陛下将求雨之功收揽己身。若可掌控天时之事宣扬出去，旁的地方遭了灾害，万民企盼，请求陛下出手，又该如何？我们救是不救？”
说话引导是一门艺术，盛州各地宣扬的都是：陛下遣人降雨救灾，遣的什么人不重要，重要的是‘陛下’遣的。百姓下意识会认为，主导权在陛下的手中，核心力量掌控在朝廷手中。
这确实在最大程度上压低了修士玄奇仙法对民众的影响，但是无形之中却也过分提高了谢苍荣的声望。
总有人要承接降雨之功。
谢苍荣只是个人，人王也是人，并非无所不能。
声望这个东西并不是越高就一定越好的。
高到超出掌控，便是捧，捧之后……便是杀。
每一份超出规格的追捧崇拜，在背后都标有价格。
归根结底，大夏现在没有掌控天时的力量。
齐修知道谢苍荣的脾性，私下会面无需顾忌。他没有像朝堂上的云昭那般斟酌词句，他一脸严肃，语声低哑：“陛下终结乱世，一统天下之功已然旷古烁今，无人企及。如今再高一层，恍若踏足缥缈楼阁，稍有不慎，便如滚石坠渊，不可遏制。”
这件事不算大事，却可以反映出一个讯号，表达皇帝的态度。
他所忧心的是，谢苍荣为了与修士争锋，盲目压制，以至于乱了自己的节奏。被捧在高处，便是被无数双眼睛关注着，反受其累，稍稍失误一点，便可能会对自己的统治大厦造成毁灭性的打击。
在齐修看来，这件事情完全可以做冷处理，不宣扬修士，也不拔高君主，就当是一场自然降雨，朝廷不表态。就算是有人看见了，给修士一点声望，让其施加一点影响，也无关于大局。
“呵呵~”
谢苍荣闻言却是不禁笑了声，挑眉看他，笑意盈盈，意气风发：“齐卿，朕这不是还没倒么？为王哪一天不是站在缥缈楼阁之上？”

“臣民奉我若神明，那朕便是神明。”
“朕只要一直都不倒，不就行了？”
如此狂狷，如此自信。
齐修闻言顿时语噎，整个人都恍惚了一下。
当初这人也就是这般昂扬自信，以弱势之姿击败了他当时效忠的如日中天的主公。
这位陛下是个辩才，他是知晓的。
理智回笼，齐修问道：“陛下如此笃定，可否让臣安心？如若民众祈求陛下救灾该如何？我朝没有掌控天时的力量，难道要求助修士么？暴露薄弱之处，岂非授人以柄？”
打肿了脸充胖子不可取。
谢苍荣却没有直接回答，只是问道：“齐卿相信那些人的手段么？相信他们是修仙之人么？”
盛州的消息还没有传回来，修者的力量尚未得到证明，时至今日朝堂上已然有许多人不相信他们。
但是显然，齐修这位内阁首辅是相信了。
齐修顿了顿，回道：“臣信陛下的判断。”
谢苍荣站在窗前，静静地看着窗外晦暗的天空：“朕告诉你，现在千里之外，盛州正在下一场三月未有的豪雨。”
“嗯？”
content_en:
"What if?"
It was raining outside the window, and Xie Cangrong stood by the window, looking quietly through the gap in the window lattice.
He was also meeting the ministers in private, but at this moment his face was calm and a little serious, not as warm as when he was in front of Liu Bingxuan and Gong Qiao.
"Qi Qing, the credit must be attributed to someone. If I don't take it, should it be given to the monks? Make the people respect and believe in it, treat it like a god, so that the 'Dharma King' is superior to the 'Human King'?"
Standing in front of Xie Cangrong was a man of about forty years old. He was tall, with a thin face. He was dressed in gray robes, his eyebrows were lowered, and he didn't look energetic.
He frowned when he heard this: "Your Majesty will take the merit of praying for rain into your own hands. What if the thing that can control the weather is publicized, and a nearby place is hit by a disaster, and thousands of people are looking forward to it, and beg your Majesty to take action, what should we do? Should we save it or not?"
Speaking and guiding is an art, and what is preached all over Shengzhou is: Your Majesty sends people to send rain for disaster relief. It does not matter who you send, what is important is that 'Your Majesty' sends it. The people will subconsciously believe that the leadership is in the hands of His Majesty and the core power is in the hands of the court.
This indeed minimized the influence of the monk's mysterious magic on the people to the greatest extent, but it also invisibly increased Xie Cangrong's reputation too much.
There is always someone who has to take over the responsibility for the rainfall.
Xie Cangrong is just a human being, and the King of Humans is also a human being, and he is not omnipotent.
Prestige is not necessarily the better.
If it's too high to be controlled, it's praise, and after praise... it's killing.
Every piece of adoration that exceeds specifications has a price tag on the back.
In the final analysis, Daxia now does not have the power to control the weather.
Qi Xiu knew Xie Cangrong's temperament, so there was no need to worry about meeting in private. He did not consider his words like Yun Zhao in the court. He had a serious face and said in a low voice: "Your Majesty ended the troubled times and unified the world. His achievements are unprecedented and unparalleled. Now one level higher, it is like stepping on a ethereal pavilion. If you are not careful, you will be like a rolling stone falling into the abyss, unstoppable."
This matter is not a big deal, but it can reflect a signal and express the emperor's attitude.
What he was worried about was that in order to compete with the monks, Xie Cangrong blindly suppressed him and disrupted his own rhythm. To be held high is to be watched by countless pairs of eyes, and you will be burdened by it. A slight mistake may cause a devastating blow to your ruling building.
In Qi Xiu's view, this matter can be treated coldly. The monks will not be promoted or the monarch will be promoted. It will be treated as a natural rainfall and the court will not express its position. Even if someone sees it, giving the monk a little reputation and letting him exert a little influence will not matter to the overall situation.
"Haha~"
Xie Cangrong couldn't help but laugh when he heard this. He raised his eyebrows and looked at him with a smile and high spirits: "Qi Qing, haven't I fallen yet? When has the king not stood on the misty pavilion?"
"If my subjects worship me as a god, then I am a god."
"As long as I don't fall down, that'll be fine, right?"
So arrogant, so confident.
Qi Xiu suddenly choked up when he heard the words, and his whole body was in a trance.
At the beginning, this man was so high-spirited and confident, and in a weak position defeated the lord he was loyal to at the time.
His Majesty is an eloquent man and he knows it.
After returning to his senses, Qi Xiu asked: "Your Majesty is so sure, can you reassure me? What if the people pray to your Majesty for disaster relief? Our government does not have the power to control the weather, should we ask for help from monks? Exposing weaknesses is not giving others leverage."
It is not advisable to pretend to be fat with a swollen face.
Xie Cangrong did not answer directly, but just asked: "Does Qi Qing believe those people's methods? Do you believe they are immortal cultivators?"
The news from Shengzhou has not yet come back, and the cultivators' power has not yet been proven. Even today, many people in the court do not believe them.But obviously, Qi Xiu, the chief minister of the cabinet, believed it.
Qi Xiu paused and replied: "I trust your Majesty's judgment."
Xie Cangrong stood in front of the window, quietly looking at the dark sky outside the window: "I tell you, thousands of miles away, Shengzhou is experiencing a heavy rain that has not been seen in March."
"Huh?"
